jobs.title: Salon Manager
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Salon Manager for a unisex salon in NAF Valley Estate, Asokoro, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.

Supervise and schedule the barbers, stylists, nail technicians and other salon workers, and keep service standards high. Manage salon inventory: track products and supplies, reorder before stock runs out and report on stock levels. Handle customer bookings, complaints and feedback, and keep the owner updated on staff, stock and daily activity.
